tools.name: yardstick_identity
tools.description: Return the current Yardstick API principal context.

tools.name: yardstick_tasks_list
tools.description: List Yardstick tasks visible to the current principal.

tools.name: yardstick_tasks_deep_link
tools.description: Create a public task deep link for a caller-supplied task id.

tools.name: yardstick_people_list
tools.description: List people visible to the current principal. Pass email to find the exact person behind a candidate_email_conflict.

tools.name: yardstick_people_read
tools.description: Read one person by public id.

tools.name: yardstick_people_documents_list
tools.description: List the documents attached to a person (resumes and other files). Archived documents are excluded unless include_archived is true. Takes a per_ display id and returns pdoc_ display ids.

tools.name: yardstick_people_documents_download_url
tools.description: Mint a signed download URL for one person document. Read-only. The URL expires in 5 minutes and is a bearer link: do not log or share it. Takes per_ and pdoc_ display ids.

tools.name: yardstick_people_create
tools.description: Create a person through the public Yardstick API.

tools.name: yardstick_people_update
tools.description: Update one person with schema-bound public API fields.

tools.name: yardstick_talent_search
tools.description: Search all authorized recruiting records by literal keywords across names, notes, activities and current parsed résumés. All words must match; PhD punctuation is normalized.

tools.name: yardstick_prospects_list
tools.description: List active Talent CRM prospects visible to the current principal.

tools.name: yardstick_prospects_read
tools.description: Read one Talent CRM prospect by public id.

tools.name: yardstick_prospects_create
tools.description: Create Talent CRM prospect relationship state for an existing person.

tools.name: yardstick_prospects_convert_preview
tools.description: Preview conversion of one Prospect into one canonical Application; bind fields are rejected and no outreach/import/merge occurs.

tools.name: yardstick_prospects_convert_bind
tools.description: Bind an approved prospect conversion preview with explicit approval metadata and matching idempotency key.

tools.name: yardstick_prospects_outreach_preview
tools.description: Preview a one-off prospect outreach draft without creating a draft, sending email, enrolling a sequence, or creating an application.

tools.name: yardstick_prospects_outreach_create_draft
tools.description: Create a pending review prospect outreach email draft. Sending stays on email draft send and requires communications:send.

tools.name: yardstick_prospect_imports_dry_run
tools.description: Preview a structured-row Prospect CRM import. JSON rows only; no raw CSV/resume file reads, outreach, application conversion, source ranking, or silent person merge.

tools.name: yardstick_prospect_imports_read
tools.description: Read one Prospect CRM import dry-run/apply batch by public id.

tools.name: yardstick_prospect_imports_apply
tools.description: Apply an approved Prospect CRM import preview with preview_hash and explicit row decisions for advisory matches.

tools.name: yardstick_ats_imports_dry_run
tools.description: Preview a structured-row ATS import of candidates, jobs, and applications (source_kind: csv). JSON rows only; no raw CSV/archive file reads, no application conversion side effects, and low-confidence stage/fuzzy matches require explicit apply decisions.

tools.name: yardstick_ats_imports_read
tools.description: Read one ATS import dry-run/apply batch and its rows by public id.

tools.name: yardstick_ats_imports_apply
tools.description: Apply an approved ATS import preview with a preview_hash matching the stored dry-run. Creates people/jobs/interview_plans(stub)/job_postings/applications with idempotent replay; never sends outreach, merges people, or deletes records.

tools.name: yardstick_source_links_list
tools.description: List source/referral attribution links without raw token material or source quality ranking.

tools.name: yardstick_source_links_read
tools.description: Read one source/referral attribution link by public id without raw token material.

tools.name: yardstick_source_links_create
tools.description: Create an opaque source/referral link for a published job posting. Raw source_token is returned only in the create response; reads return token_hint, and active token-bearing links also return public_url.

tools.name: yardstick_source_links_disable
tools.description: Disable a source/referral link so its public URL no longer stamps attribution.

tools.name: yardstick_prospects_update
tools.description: Update bounded Talent CRM prospect relationship fields.

tools.name: yardstick_prospect_activities_list
tools.description: List bounded activity records for one Talent CRM prospect.

tools.name: yardstick_prospect_activities_create
tools.description: Create a bounded internal prospect activity note or touchpoint.

tools.name: yardstick_talent_pools_list
tools.description: List Talent CRM pools visible to the current principal. Archived pools are excluded unless include_archived is true.

tools.name: yardstick_talent_pools_read
tools.description: Read one Talent CRM pool by public id.

tools.name: yardstick_talent_pools_create
tools.description: Create a Talent CRM pool.

tools.name: yardstick_talent_pools_update
tools.description: Update bounded Talent CRM pool fields.

tools.name: yardstick_talent_pool_members_list
tools.description: List active prospect memberships for one Talent CRM pool.

tools.name: yardstick_talent_pool_members_add
tools.description: Add an existing prospect to a Talent CRM pool.

tools.name: yardstick_talent_pool_members_remove
tools.description: Remove an active prospect membership from a Talent CRM pool.

tools.name: yardstick_applications_list
tools.description: List application person + Job attachments visible to the current principal.

tools.name: yardstick_applications_read
tools.description: Read one application person + Job attachment by public id.

tools.name: yardstick_applications_create
tools.description: Create a recruiter or agent-sourced application for an existing person and job posting.

tools.name: yardstick_applications_update
tools.description: Update one application with schema-bound public API fields.

tools.name: yardstick_applications_transition_direct
tools.description: Directly write a non-terminal application transition; approval-only statuses are rejected. Optionally target a configured stage by id with pipeline_stage_id (the resolved stage is reported back).

tools.name: yardstick_applications_transition_preview
tools.description: Preview approval-required application transitions only; bind fields and direct-write targets are rejected. Optionally target a configured stage by id with pipeline_stage_id (status must match the stage's mapped status).

tools.name: yardstick_applications_transition_bind
tools.description: Bind an already-previewed application transition with explicit approval metadata and matching idempotency key.

tools.name: yardstick_applications_archive_preview
tools.description: Preview application archive approval requirements only; bind fields are rejected.

tools.name: yardstick_applications_archive_bind
tools.description: Bind an already-previewed application archive with explicit approval metadata and matching idempotency key.

tools.name: yardstick_applications_status_email_poc_preview
tools.description: Preview the fixed applications-owned Interviewing to Offer status/email approval POC without mutating status or email state.

tools.name: yardstick_applications_status_email_poc_bind
tools.description: Bind the fixed applications-owned status/email approval POC with explicit approval metadata and a matching idempotency key.

tools.name: yardstick_decision_brief_read
tools.description: Read the decision brief for an application.

tools.name: yardstick_decision_brief_regenerate
tools.description: Regenerate a decision brief for an application with idempotency metadata.

tools.name: yardstick_applications_email_decision_preview
tools.description: Preview the candidate email decision for an application status change without mutating the application or drafts.

tools.name: yardstick_applications_email_decision_apply
tools.description: Apply an application status-change email decision with idempotency metadata.

tools.name: yardstick_email_drafts_list
tools.description: List candidate email drafts with optional status and email-type filters.

tools.name: yardstick_email_drafts_read
tools.description: Read a redacted candidate email draft.

tools.name: yardstick_email_drafts_preview
tools.description: Read rendered preview content for a candidate email draft.

tools.name: yardstick_email_drafts_history
tools.description: Read candidate email draft history and provenance.

tools.name: yardstick_email_drafts_update
tools.description: Save mutable candidate email draft fields or set/clear a validated sender override.

tools.name: yardstick_email_drafts_send
tools.description: Send a pending candidate email draft with replay protection, or reclaim a never-delivered draft and send it.

tools.name: yardstick_email_drafts_discard
tools.description: Discard a pending candidate email draft without provider mutation.

tools.name: yardstick_email_automation_settings_read
tools.description: Read candidate email automation settings.

tools.name: yardstick_email_automation_settings_update
tools.description: Update candidate email automation settings.

tools.name: yardstick_email_sender_settings_read
tools.description: Read redacted email sender settings with sanitized queue diagnostics.

tools.name: yardstick_email_sender_connections_list
tools.description: List redacted sender provider connection state.

tools.name: yardstick_email_sender_defaults_list
tools.description: List candidate email sender defaults.

tools.name: yardstick_integrations_workspace_health_read
tools.description: Read sanitized Workspace integration health diagnostics.

tools.name: yardstick_email_sender_defaults_set
tools.description: Set the default sender policy for a candidate email type.

tools.name: yardstick_email_templates_list
tools.description: List candidate email template policies without raw prompts.

tools.name: yardstick_email_templates_read
tools.description: Read candidate email template detail without raw prompts.

tools.name: yardstick_email_templates_preview
tools.description: Preview a candidate email template for sample variables.

tools.name: yardstick_email_templates_validate
tools.description: Validate candidate email template subject, HTML, and text bodies.

tools.name: yardstick_email_templates_publish
tools.description: Publish a validated candidate email template version.

tools.name: yardstick_email_template_versions_list
tools.description: List immutable candidate email template versions.

tools.name: yardstick_email_templates_rollback
tools.description: Rollback a candidate email template to an immutable version.

tools.name: yardstick_email_templates_preview_customization
tools.description: Preview AI sample customization for a candidate email template without publishing.

tools.name: yardstick_final_recommendation_record
tools.description: Record direct final-recommendation evidence; this does not mutate application status.

tools.name: yardstick_application_interview_sessions_list
tools.description: List interview sessions for an application.

tools.name: yardstick_application_interview_sessions_ensure
tools.description: Ensure an application interview session for an explicit round id.

tools.name: yardstick_opportunities_list
tools.description: List read-only opportunity workflow views visible to the current principal.

tools.name: yardstick_opportunities_read
tools.description: Read one read-only opportunity workflow view by public id.

tools.name: yardstick_opportunities_next_action
tools.description: Read the next action state for an opportunity without mutating it.

tools.name: yardstick_opportunities_deep_link
tools.description: Create a public deep link for an opportunity workflow view.

tools.name: yardstick_reporting_search
tools.description: Search redacted recruiting reporting summaries through the public reporting API.

tools.name: yardstick_departments_list
tools.description: List Departments visible to the current principal.

tools.name: yardstick_departments_read
tools.description: Read one Department by public id.

tools.name: yardstick_departments_create
tools.description: Create a Department through the public Yardstick API.

tools.name: yardstick_departments_update
tools.description: Update one Department with schema-bound public API fields.

tools.name: yardstick_departments_members_list
tools.description: List Department members for an authorized Department.

tools.name: yardstick_departments_members_add
tools.description: Add an existing person to a Department.

tools.name: yardstick_departments_members_set_lead
tools.description: Set one Department member as lead.

tools.name: yardstick_departments_members_remove
tools.description: Remove a Department member, optionally with a replacement lead.

tools.name: yardstick_departments_invitations_list
tools.description: List redacted Department invitation views.

tools.name: yardstick_departments_invitations_create
tools.description: Create a Department-scoped invitation without returning token material.

tools.name: yardstick_access_grants_list
tools.description: List explicit access grants visible to the current principal.

tools.name: yardstick_access_grants_read
tools.description: Read one explicit access grant by public id.

tools.name: yardstick_access_grants_create
tools.description: Create a reasoned, revocable, audited access grant.

tools.name: yardstick_access_grants_revoke
tools.description: Revoke an explicit access grant with optional reason text.

tools.name: yardstick_jobs_list
tools.description: List internal Job containers visible to the current principal.

tools.name: yardstick_jobs_create
tools.description: Create an internal Job container without mutating job postings, applications, or interview plans.

tools.name: yardstick_jobs_read
tools.description: Read one internal Job container by public id.

tools.name: yardstick_jobs_prospect_matches
tools.description: List deterministic Talent CRM prospect matches for one Job. Read-only; includes evidence, caveats, and blocked lifecycle states without outreach, conversion, import, or AI ranking.

tools.name: yardstick_jobs_update
tools.description: Update one internal Job container with schema-bound public API fields.

tools.name: yardstick_jobs_close
tools.description: Close one Job row only; linked job postings, applications, and interview plans are not mutated.

tools.name: yardstick_jobs_archive
tools.description: Archive one Job row only; linked job postings, applications, and interview plans are not mutated.

tools.name: yardstick_jobs_attach_artifact
tools.description: Link an existing interview plan, job posting, or application to a Job. Idempotent when already linked to the same Job; conflicts when linked elsewhere. Requires jobs:write and the artifact's own write scope.

tools.name: yardstick_jobs_detach_artifact
tools.description: Clear the link between an artifact and a Job. Idempotent when already unlinked. Requires jobs:write and the artifact's own write scope.

tools.name: yardstick_pipelines_list
tools.description: List the organization's pipeline templates with their ordered stages. Canonical default stages are flagged canonical_locked.

tools.name: yardstick_pipelines_read
tools.description: Read one pipeline template and its ordered stages by public id.

tools.name: yardstick_pipelines_create
tools.description: Create a custom pipeline template with optional inline stages. Does not affect the org default pipeline or candidate tracking.

tools.name: yardstick_pipelines_update
tools.description: Rename, re-describe, or toggle active for one pipeline template.

tools.name: yardstick_pipelines_stages_create
tools.description: Append (or insert at a position) a stage to a pipeline with a kind and optional approval scope.

tools.name: yardstick_pipelines_stages_update
tools.description: Edit a pipeline stage. Canonical default stages allow display-name change only; slug/stage_kind/approval_scope/is_terminal are locked.

tools.name: yardstick_pipelines_reorder_stages
tools.description: Reorder all stages of a pipeline by supplying the complete stage id order. Constraint-safe; allowed for canonical stages.

tools.name: yardstick_pipelines_stages_delete_preview
tools.description: Preview deleting a pipeline stage; returns the candidate-count impact and binding fields. Canonical default stages are rejected.

tools.name: yardstick_pipelines_stages_delete_bind
tools.description: Bind an approved pipeline-stage delete with explicit approval metadata and a matching idempotency key. Refuses while candidates remain.

tools.name: yardstick_pipelines_assign_to_job
tools.description: Assign a pipeline to a job (jobs.pipeline_template_id) or clear it with pipeline_id: null. Pipeline validated by org; job resolved by org+mode.

tools.name: yardstick_automation_rules_list
tools.description: List the organization's stage automation rules. Rules are inert config — authoring fires no side effect; the executor child runs rules later.

tools.name: yardstick_automation_runs_list
tools.description: List the organization's stage automation runs (what fired for which candidate, success/failure). Filterable by application-id and rule-id. Read-only; runs are system-written by the executor and include skipped (deferred) send_email rows so run state is fully observable.

tools.name: yardstick_automation_rules_read
tools.description: Read one stage automation rule by public id (its trigger, typed action, target stage, and is_active state).

tools.name: yardstick_automation_rules_create
tools.description: Create a stage automation rule (trigger + typed action from the 3-type palette: send_scheduling_link / create_task / send_email). Inert — fires no side effect.

tools.name: yardstick_automation_rules_update
tools.description: Edit a stage automation rule's trigger, typed action, condition, position, or is_active state.

tools.name: yardstick_automation_rules_delete
tools.description: Delete a stage automation rule. Plain delete (no approval preview→bind): rules are inert config, so deleting unfired config moves no candidates.

tools.name: yardstick_automation_rules_preview
tools.description: Dry-run preview: resolve the active rules + their resolved action params for a sample application entering/leaving a stage. INERT — mints no scheduling link, creates no task, sends no email; executes nothing.

tools.name: yardstick_built_in_agents_list
tools.description: List the built-in-agent catalog with each built-in agent's current status, explicit defaults or disabled state, and latest work summary.

tools.name: yardstick_built_in_agents_read
tools.description: Read one built-in agent by catalog id (for example scorecard-chaser, nightly-screening, or interview-kit-prep): what it does, what it never does without you, current status, and latest work summary.

tools.name: yardstick_built_in_agents_runs
tools.description: List the organization's built-in-agent run history as a flat work report. Nightly screening reports scheduled-work counts and held, released, or invalidated review outputs; interview-kit preparation reports the scheduled week and count-only results. It never includes candidate, draft, recipient, kit

tools.name: yardstick_built_in_agents_enable_preview
tools.description: Preview enabling a built-in agent; returns the approval-required envelope stating exactly what starts happening (and what is never sent without you) plus binding fields. Side-effect free.

tools.name: yardstick_built_in_agents_enable_bind
tools.description: Bind an approved built-in-agent enable preview with explicit approval metadata and a matching idempotency key. Writes the built-in agent's declared settings home and records one audit row.

tools.name: yardstick_built_in_agents_configure_preview
tools.description: Preview configuring a built-in agent (config is validated against the built-in agent's declared schema; enabled is a first-class key, so { enabled: false } is the off switch). Side-effect free; pass config via --body-json.

tools.name: yardstick_built_in_agents_configure_bind
tools.description: Bind an approved built-in-agent configure preview (same config plus approval metadata and a matching idempotency key). Writes only the built-in agent's declared settings keys and records one audit row.

tools.name: yardstick_job_postings_list
tools.description: List job postings visible to the current principal.

tools.name: yardstick_job_postings_read
tools.description: Read one job posting by public id.

tools.name: yardstick_job_postings_validate
tools.description: Validate a draft job posting without mutating it.

tools.name: yardstick_job_postings_create
tools.description: Create a draft job posting through the public Yardstick API.

tools.name: yardstick_job_postings_update
tools.description: Update a job posting with schema-bound public API fields.

tools.name: yardstick_job_postings_publish_preview
tools.description: Preview job-posting publish approval requirements only; bind fields are rejected.

tools.name: yardstick_job_postings_publish_bind
tools.description: Bind an already-previewed job-posting publish with explicit approval metadata and matching idempotency key.

tools.name: yardstick_job_postings_archive_preview
tools.description: Preview job-posting archive approval requirements only; bind fields are rejected.

tools.name: yardstick_job_postings_archive_bind
tools.description: Bind an already-previewed job-posting archive with explicit approval metadata and matching idempotency key.

tools.name: yardstick_interview_plans_list
tools.description: List published interview plans, newest first. Optional job_id narrows the list to one job and takes a job_ public display id. Use this to find an interview plan id when you only hold a job id.

tools.name: yardstick_interview_plans_read
tools.description: Read one interview plan by public id.

tools.name: yardstick_interview_plans_archive
tools.description: Archive one interview plan. Already-archived plans succeed without a write. A plan still attached to a job is refused — detach it from the job first.

tools.name: yardstick_interview_plans_unarchive
tools.description: Restore one archived interview plan. Plans that are already live succeed without a write. If the plan's job has since acquired another live plan, the restore is refused and names that plan.

tools.name: yardstick_interview_plan_drafts_generate_outcomes
tools.description: Generate draft interview-plan outcomes from explicit role context, or pass accepted_outcomes to store caller-written outcomes verbatim with no AI generation (the deterministic draft bootstrap).

tools.name: yardstick_interview_plan_drafts_confirm_outcomes
tools.description: Confirm draft interview-plan outcomes before generating later stages.

tools.name: yardstick_interview_plan_drafts_generate_competencies
tools.description: Generate draft interview-plan competencies from confirmed outcomes.

tools.name: yardstick_interview_plan_drafts_generate_skills
tools.description: Generate draft interview-plan skills from confirmed competencies.

tools.name: yardstick_interview_plan_drafts_generate_rounds
tools.description: Generate draft interview-plan rounds from confirmed skills.

tools.name: yardstick_interview_plan_drafts_generate_anchors
tools.description: Generate scorecard behavioral anchors (levels 1-4) for each draft competency, or one competency when competency_id is supplied.

tools.name: yardstick_interview_plan_drafts_generate_questions_directions
tools.description: Generate interview questions and interviewer/candidate directions for each draft round, or one round when round_id is supplied.

tools.name: yardstick_interview_plan_drafts_list
tools.description: List interview-plan drafts, newest first. Optional job_id narrows the list to one job and takes a job_ public display id. Use this to find an ipd_ draft id again after an interrupted builder session.

tools.name: yardstick_interview_plan_drafts_read
tools.description: Read one interview-plan draft in full: every stage checkpoint (outcomes, competencies, job skills, interview sequence, questions and directions), stage_versions for source_stage preconditions, status, and source metadata. Question ids are always present (question_N fallback), so edits can target the

tools.name: yardstick_interview_plan_drafts_add_competencies
tools.description: Add competencies to a draft exactly as written — deterministic, no AI generation. Requires confirmed outcomes; the resulting stage must stay within 25 competencies. Optional source_stage {stage: competencies, version} returns 409 when stale.

tools.name: yardstick_interview_plan_drafts_update_competencies
tools.description: Replace draft competencies by id and/or reorder them with order (a complete permutation of resulting ids) — deterministic, no AI generation. Updating in place keeps the item id. Optional source_stage {stage: competencies, version} returns 409 when stale.

tools.name: yardstick_interview_plan_drafts_delete_competencies
tools.description: Delete draft competencies by id. Prunes each deleted competency's behavioral anchors in the same write and reports the pruned ids; the stage must keep at least one competency. Optional source_stage {stage: competencies, version} returns 409 when stale.

tools.name: yardstick_interview_plan_drafts_add_skills
tools.description: Add job skills to a draft exactly as written — deterministic, no AI generation. Requires competencies; the resulting stage must stay within 50 skills. Optional source_stage {stage: skills, version} returns 409 when stale.

tools.name: yardstick_interview_plan_drafts_update_skills
tools.description: Replace draft job skills by id and/or reorder them with order (a complete permutation of resulting ids) — deterministic, no AI generation. Optional source_stage {stage: skills, version} returns 409 when stale.

tools.name: yardstick_interview_plan_drafts_delete_skills
tools.description: Delete draft job skills by id; the stage must keep at least one skill. Optional source_stage {stage: skills, version} returns 409 when stale.

tools.name: yardstick_interview_plan_drafts_add_rounds
tools.description: Add interview rounds to a draft exactly as written — deterministic, no AI generation. Requires skills; the resulting sequence must stay within 20 rounds. Optional source_stage {stage: interview_sequence, version} returns 409 when stale.

tools.name: yardstick_interview_plan_drafts_update_rounds
tools.description: Replace draft interview rounds by id and/or reorder them with order (a complete permutation of resulting ids) — deterministic, no AI generation. tools.name: yardstick_interview_plan_drafts_delete_rounds
tools.description: Delete draft interview rounds by id. Prunes each deleted round's questions and directions in the same write and reports the pruned ids; the sequence must keep at least one round. Optional source_stage {stage: interview_sequence, version} returns 409 when stale.

tools.name: yardstick_interview_plan_drafts_add_questions
tools.description: Add questions to one draft round exactly as written — deterministic, no AI generation. Requires rounds; each round holds at most 50 questions. The first question edit on a round persists question_N ids for every question in that round. Optional source_stage {stage: questions_and_directions, version}

tools.name: yardstick_interview_plan_drafts_update_questions
tools.description: Replace one draft round's questions by id and/or reorder them with order (a complete permutation of that round's resulting question ids) — deterministic, no AI generation. Read the draft first: stored questions expose stable question_N ids. Optional source_stage {stage: questions_and_directions, ver

tools.name: yardstick_interview_plan_drafts_delete_questions
tools.description: Delete questions from one draft round by question id. Optional source_stage {stage: questions_and_directions, version} returns 409 when stale.

tools.name: yardstick_interview_plan_drafts_update_round_directions
tools.description: Set one draft round's interviewer and/or candidate directions exactly as written — deterministic, no AI generation. Provide at least one of the two direction fields. Optional source_stage {stage: questions_and_directions, version} returns 409 when stale.

tools.name: yardstick_interview_plan_drafts_update_anchors
tools.description: Upsert behavioral anchors for draft items, keyed by item id with levels 1-4 — deterministic, no AI generation. Requires competencies; anchors keyed to unknown item ids are rejected by id. Optional source_stage {stage: questions_and_directions, version} returns 409 when stale.

tools.name: yardstick_interview_plan_drafts_delete_anchors
tools.description: Delete behavioral-anchor entries for draft items by item id. Optional source_stage {stage: questions_and_directions, version} returns 409 when stale.

tools.name: yardstick_interview_plan_drafts_clear_outcomes
tools.description: Clear every outcome from a draft, leaving the stage deliberately empty — deterministic, no AI generation. tools.name: yardstick_interview_plan_drafts_clear_competencies

tools.description: Clear every job skill from a draft, leaving the stage deliberately empty — deterministic, no AI generation. tools.description: Clear every interview round from a draft, leaving the stage deliberately empty — deterministic, no AI generation. tools.name: yardstick_interview_plan_drafts_validate
tools.description: Validate an interview-plan draft without publishing it.

tools.name: yardstick_interview_plans_publish_preview
tools.description: Preview interview-plan publish approval requirements only; bind fields are rejected.

tools.name: yardstick_interview_plans_publish_bind
tools.description: Bind an already-previewed interview-plan publish with explicit approval metadata and matching idempotency key.

tools.name: yardstick_interview_plans_modify_active_preview
tools.description: Preview interview-plan active-modification approval requirements only; bind fields are rejected.

tools.name: yardstick_interview_plans_modify_active_bind
tools.description: Bind an already-previewed interview-plan active modification with explicit approval metadata and matching idempotency key.

tools.name: yardstick_interview_sessions_read
tools.description: Read one interview session by public id.

tools.name: yardstick_interview_sessions_interviewers_list
tools.description: List interviewers assigned to an interview session.

tools.name: yardstick_interview_sessions_available_interviewers_list

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "yardstick_interview_sessions_interviewers_assign" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Assign an interviewer to an interview session." → after: "Assign an interviewer to an interview session. Email notification is attempted by default; set notify_interviewer to false to opt out. The response reports the safe interviewer_email outcome."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
